stages.title: Foundation
stages.goal: A complete, empty monorepo in which every guard against parallel-agent failures works before any product code exists.
exit_criteria: Every packages[] folder exists with a README and an ARCHITECTURE.md; package map and versions are filled in.
A fresh clone installs reproducibly with the committed lockfile; root lint, typecheck, test and build pass.
Two worktrees run install, lint, typecheck and tests side by side without port or database collision; tools/dev/setup and teardown create and remove the slot database and bucket and refuse slot 0.
design-check, language-check, changelog-entry and boundaries reject a violating change locally; every code change carries a .changes entry.

The CI workflow is authored and proven locally (actionlint + act) and local sessions use Polier at the board's generator_version; the real GitHub run, branch protection, hosting and releases are deferred to the remote stage after hardening (ADR-0003).
A runnable design preview page exists with desktop and mobile screenshots and a live two-note connection demo (P0-19, P0-20).

stages.title: Contract
stages.goal: The shared language (data model, operations, sync protocol, API errors) exists as versioned JSON Schema with fixtures and TS + C++ codegen.
exit_criteria: contracts 0.1.0 tagged; every schema has a valid and an invalid fixture.
TS and C++ read the same fixtures identically.

stages.title: Engine spike
stages.goal: Prove that the own C++/WebAssembly engine reaches the performance targets; owner decides continue or plan B.
exit_criteria: 60 fps with 50,000 rectangles on the reference hardware; WASM <= 300 KB gzip.
Measured report and ADR for the engine architecture.

stages.title: Backend core
stages.goal: Accounts, permissions and durable data without any hosted backend vendor.
exit_criteria: API suite covers allow and deny for every route; RLS tests green.
A script creates account, workspace, board and note via the SDK; a second account sees nothing.

stages.title: Engine core
stages.goal: Display and edit board content in the engine, still without a server.
exit_criteria: 10,000 objects at 60 fps in the playground.
All engine entries of the canvas work orders done; reference images green.

stages.title: Realtime
stages.goal: Several people edit one board at the same time without losing data.
exit_criteria: Load test 25 clients p95 <= 150 ms; restart loses no acknowledged change.
Two offline browsers converge after reconnect.

stages.title: Web app
stages.goal: The product in one piece: web app on SDK, engine and sync.
exit_criteria: Main e2e flows green on a preview environment.
Every canvas work order done with evidence; design-check and language-check green repo-wide.

stages.title: Import, export and AI
stages.goal: Data in and out, coach, sharing and comments.
exit_criteria: Ten sample boards imported with a per-object checklist; JSON export round-trips.
Coach budget enforced.

stages.title: Hardening and beta
stages.goal: Production-ready operations and a closed beta.
exit_criteria: All product targets measured; no open high-severity security findings.
Two weeks of beta without data loss.

stages.title: Remote
stages.goal: GitHub protection, CI, pinned Polier in CI, tag-based releases, preview/staging/production smoke and update automation, after the local build.
exit_criteria: main is protected; CI rejects a pull request outside its scope, with raw colours, hard-coded UI text or without a change entry.
Polier v1.0.0 is pinned in CI; release 0.0.1 and one preview ran end to end from a tag.
Hosting is chosen (Q3), environments and smoke checks are complete.

stages.title: Public v1
exit_criteria: Release 1.0.0 built by CI from a tag; smoke checks green on every environment.

tasks.title: Protect main and document repository settings
tasks.goal: main accepts changes only through pull requests with green CI and one review, and the settings are documented.
tasks.why: Every later task merges through this protection; without it CI cannot stop a bad merge.

tasks.title: Workspace folders, package READMEs and architectures
tasks.goal: Every packages[] folder exists with a README stating its purpose and an ARCHITECTURE.md, and the package map lists them.
tasks.why: All later tasks write inside these folders; check.py requires them.
handoff: Closed P0-03: all 21 package folders with README and ARCHITECTURE (173-284 words), tests/README.
Gates board-check and boundaries pass; commands remain 'set by P0-04'.
P0-04 can build the workspace on top; P0-07 can add infra/compose.

tasks.title: Workspaces, build orchestration and pinned versions
tasks.goal: The root workspace installs reproducibly, builds only changed packages and every tool version is pinned with source.
tasks.why: Every package task needs working install, lint, typecheck and test commands.
handoff: Closed P0-04: pnpm workspaces + Turborepo, exact tool versions, lockfile committed, Node 24.22.1 LTS pinned.
install = pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; unit = pnpm test; root lint/typecheck/test/build exit 0 on the empty workspace.
Board-check runs before pnpm install (check.py scans node_modules); P0-06, P0-12 and P0-18 can start.

tasks.title: Per-slot dev setup and teardown
tasks.goal: Each worktree gets its own ports, database and bucket from .polier-slot through tools/dev/setup and teardown.
tasks.why: Parallel test runs must never collide (AD-9).
handoff: Closed P0-06: tools/dev/setup and tools/dev/teardown read slot, db_name and bucket only from .polier-slot.
setup starts the shared compose stack and creates the slot DB/bucket idempotently; teardown drops them and refuses slot 0.
Verified with real runs on slot 1 (log in reviews/evidence/); P0-18 and later services can use it.

tasks.title: Local services compose
tasks.goal: PostgreSQL, S3-compatible storage and a mail catcher start locally with one command.
tasks.why: Backend, media and auth tasks need these services.
handoff: Closed P0-07: infra/compose with PostgreSQL 17.11, SeaweedFS 4.50 (S3) and Mailpit 1.32.0, pinned, healthy, loopback ports 5433/8333/1025/8025.
Gate compose-config passes; images recorded in docs/versions.md, gate command in docs/quality.md.
P0-06 reads .polier-slot and creates per-slot DB/bucket against this stack; never resets slot 0 data.

tasks.title: CI skeleton
tasks.goal: Every pull request runs the board check, boundaries, install, lint, typecheck, tests and the tool gates through one CI workflow, proven locally now.
tasks.why: All later gates plug into this pipeline.
handoff: Closed P0-08: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs board-check before install, then install/lint/typecheck/test/boundaries/design-check/language-check/changelog-entry on PRs.
Locally proven with actionlint (Docker) and every run-step executed in order; act image unavailable, real run deferred to remote.
P0-09 pins Polier through tools/polier.sh and refines the CI; actions still use major tags and need exact pins + versions rows.

tasks.title: Pinned Polier for agents and CI
tasks.goal: Local sessions and CI use Polier at exactly the board's generator_version.
tasks.why: Gate records and guards must come from the same tool version everywhere.
handoff: Closed P0-09: tools/polier.sh --check/--install/--show pins Polier v1.0.0 from board.generator_version; CI uses the wrapper.
GitHub Actions pinned by SHA and recorded in docs/versions.md (owner-approved CI tooling).
polier-version and ci-local pass; AGENTS 397 words. Foundation is complete after the owner decision.

tasks.title: Adapt design rules to this project
tasks.goal: docs/design-rules.md is created from reference/docs/design-rules.md and applies to web app and engine, with values from packages/ui-kit/tokens.json.
tasks.why: Every UI and engine task cites these rules.
handoff: Closed P0-10: docs/design-rules.md derived from the reference, adapted to tokens.json, icons, engine, Polier and i18n.
Gate board-check passes; no prototype/vendor names, no broken links.
P0-11 can build the canvas acceptance catalogue on it; P0-12/P0-13 cite it.

tasks.title: Canvas acceptance catalogue
tasks.goal: The canvas work orders become a catalogue with package, phase and evidence per entry.
tasks.why: Phase gates for engine and web check against this catalogue.
handoff: Closed P0-11: docs/canvas-acceptance.md with L00-L20, nine fields per entry, C-mapping and open points.
Gate board-check passes; all entries status open, Q15 (L13) and Q16 (L15) remain blocking.
P0-13 can enforce the catalogue; engine-core/web-app gates check entries against it.

tasks.title: Design tokens and icons in ui-kit
tasks.goal: packages/ui-kit/tokens.json generates CSS custom properties and a C++ header; the toolbar icons are SVG files.
tasks.why: AD-7: one source of visual values for web and engine.
handoff: Closed P0-12: packages/ui-kit tokens.json is the single visual source; codegen writes tokens.css, tokens.h and layers.ts deterministically.
Ten toolbar icons as SVG; package scripts lint/typecheck/test/build/codegen; 37 unit tests; AD-7 complete.
P0-13 design-check can consume tokens.json, layers.ts and icons; commands are in docs/quality.md.

tasks.title: design-check gate
tasks.goal: tools/design-check rejects raw colours, off-grid spacing, z-index outside the layer tokens and missing UI evidence.
tasks.why: Design rules must be enforced by a tool, not by memory.
handoff: Closed P0-13: tools/design-check (builtins only) rejects raw colours, off-grid spacing, z-index outside layers.ts and missing UI evidence with --task; 16 tests.
design-check and unit gates pass; findings are file:line: rule: message, deterministic.
P0-08 wires design-check into CI at the remote switch; UI tasks use --task to require before/after screenshots.

tasks.title: Change entries and changelog gate
tasks.goal: Each task adds a .changes entry; CI rejects code changes without one; CHANGELOG.md starts at 0.0.1.
tasks.why: Parallel tasks must never collide on CHANGELOG.md.
handoff: Closed P0-14: .changes/ entries for every finished task, tools/release change + check-changes tools, CHANGELOG.md at 0.0.1.
changelog-entry and unit gates pass; gate checks base...HEAD plus working tree and ignores docs/board changes.
Release stage collects entries; agents never edit CHANGELOG directly. Root version is 0.0.1.

tasks.title: Release command and tag-based CI release
tasks.goal: npm run release creates a release PR; CI tags, builds, deploys staging and waits for production approval.
tasks.why: AD-10: only clean tagged main goes live.

tasks.title: Dependency updates and Polier update check
tasks.goal: Weekly grouped dependency update pull requests run the normal CI; a check reports Polier drift.
tasks.why: Updates must flow through the same gates as code.

tasks.title: RELEASING.md and release 0.0.1
tasks.goal: RELEASING.md describes the release flow and release 0.0.1 of the empty scaffold ran through CI.
tasks.why: Proves the release path before product code exists.

tasks.title: i18n scaffold and language-check gate
tasks.goal: German and English message files with English keys exist and tools/language-check rejects German in code and UI text outside them.
tasks.why: AD-8: the site stays translatable without code changes.
handoff: Closed P0-18: de/en/en-XA message files with English ICU keys, docs/i18n glossary and German style (ss, de-DE).
tools/language-check (builtins only) enforces key parity, ICU, pseudo consistency, ss and German-in-code; 9 unit tests.
language-check and unit gates pass; web-app stage adds the ICU library and real UI text on these files.

tasks.title: Design preview page
tasks.goal: A runnable design preview page shows tokens, icons, states and a sample board at desktop and mobile width, with committed screenshots.
tasks.why: The owner wants to see the look and feel after larger milestones instead of waiting for the end; this is the first visible demo.
handoff: Closed P0-19: apps/web/preview/ is a static, dependency-free design system showcase (tokens, type, icons, states, sample board).
Serve it from the repo root on the slot web port and open /apps/web/preview/; desktop and mobile screenshots are committed.
Demo cadence is in docs/quality.md: after larger milestones build, serve, screenshot and show; no demo per small task.

tasks.title: Live connection demo in the preview
tasks.goal: The preview shows two draggable note cards connected by an edge that follows live, so the owner can feel the interaction.
tasks.why: The owner wants to feel board interaction early; this is the live follow-up to the static design preview.
handoff: Closed P0-20: apps/web/preview/ has a live two-note connection demo (pointer drag, live edge, keyboard nudge 16 px, Home reset, clamping).
board-check, changelog-entry and design-check pass; demo is section 01 above the static sections.
Serve the page and drag to feel it; engine-spike playground remains the next real engine demo.

tasks.title: Match the demo connection to the design system
tasks.goal: The live demo edge uses the design system's connection style (--tone-d, 1.5 px) and the demo stays permanent with every preview update.
tasks.why: The owner wants the demo to feel like the product; the edge style must match the Connection component.
handoff: Closed P0-21: demo edge now uses --tone-d at 1.5 px like the static Connection component; screenshot refreshed.
apps/web/preview/README.md: demo is permanent and updated in the same task as every preview/design-system change.
All three gates pass; refresh the served preview to see the tone-d edge.

tasks.title: Version and last change in the preview masthead
tasks.goal: The preview shows the changelog version and the latest change entry in a meta line at the top.
tasks.why: The owner wants the preview to identify itself with version and last change.
handoff: Closed P0-22: preview masthead shows Version 0.0.1 · unreleased · Last change P0-21.
Sources are CHANGELOG.md and the newest .changes entry; README and demo cadence require updating the line with every preview/changelog change.
Screenshot P0-22-demo.png; all three gates pass.

tasks.title: Visible connection anchors in the demo
tasks.goal: The demo cards show four connection anchors at their side midpoints and the edge snaps to the nearest anchor pair.
tasks.why: The owner wants to see where a card connects and feel the edge snapping to those points.
handoff: Closed P0-23: demo cards show four side-midpoint anchors; the edge snaps to the nearest anchor pair and highlights it in --tone-d.
Masthead meta line now shows version, last change P0-23 and timestamp 2026-10-25 11:39 (Europe/Zurich).
All three gates pass; demo, anchors and meta line are updated in the same task from now on.

tasks.title: Curved edge, visible anchors and zoom controls in the demo
tasks.goal: The live demo has a smoothly curved connection, clearly visible anchors and working +/−/Alles-anzeigen controls.
tasks.why: The owner wants the demo to feel like the intended canvas: curved edge, visible anchors, zoom controls.
handoff: Closed P0-24: demo edge is a curve along anchor normals, anchors are visible (8 px, --fg/--tone-d), and +/−/fit zoom controls work (CSS glyphs, preview-only).
Meta line shows P0-24 with date/time; controls keep drag/keyboard correct under zoom and mobile has no overflow.
Product zoom control will use ui-kit icons in the engine stage; this demo stays in sync with every preview change.

tasks.title: Grouped zoom control and invisible anchors
tasks.goal: The demo zoom control is one vertical grouped pill and the connection anchors are invisible geometry.
tasks.why: The owner wants the grouped zoom control and no visible white anchor dots.
handoff: Closed P0-25: zoom control is one vertical grouped pill (+, −, fit, CSS glyphs) and the four anchors are invisible geometry only.
Curved --tone-d edge still snaps to the nearest invisible side-midpoint anchor pair; zoom/fit/drag/keyboard/mobile unchanged.
Meta line shows P0-25 with date/time; preview demo remains in sync with every preview change.

tasks.title: Board content data model as JSON Schema
tasks.goal: packages/contracts holds the board-content data model (entities, relations, limits) as versioned JSON Schema with valid and invalid fixtures.
tasks.why: Engine, backend and web must share one contract before exchanging data (AD-3, AD-4).
handoff: Closed P1-01: packages/contracts has 9 JSON-Schema-2020-12 files (v0.1.0) for account/workspace/board/note/card/zone/block/edge/root and 35 valid+invalid fixtures.
Model covers AD-4 (note exists once, cards reference notes), parent relation, fractional index string, minimum sizes and ISO timestamps; 19 unit tests.
P1-02 adds operations/undo; P1-03 codegen; P1-06 documents the contract and fills board.contracts[].

tasks.title: Operations, inverse operations and group
tasks.goal: Every board change is one contract operation with an inverse, plus an ordered group operation, with fixtures and tests (AD-1).
tasks.why: Undo, realtime sync and the engine need one operation vocabulary; one gesture = one operation.
handoff: Closed P1-02: operation schema covers note/card/zone/block/edge create/update/delete plus move/resize and an ordered group; every operation carries exactly one inverse.
Group inverse reverses child inverses, no nesting; fixtures valid+invalid per type; unit tests pass.
P1-03 codegen consumes these schemas; ADR-0004 fixes text limits and private/workspace/link visibility (link read-only, revocable).

tasks.title: Codegen TS + C++ with identical fixtures
tasks.goal: Deterministic codegen from the contract schemas to TypeScript types and a C++ header; both read the same fixtures identically.
tasks.why: Engine (C++) and backend/web (TS) must read one contract identically (AD-3).
handoff: Closed P1-03: deterministic codegen from schemas to generated/types.ts and generated/contract.h; codegen twice leaves no diff.
Parity proof: 77 fixtures (32 valid/45 invalid) produce identical TS and C++ canonical results; local clang++ builds the C++ test without third-party libraries.
P1-04/P1-05 extend the contract; P1-06 documents/taggs 0.1.0. Generated files are committed.

tasks.title: Sync protocol messages
tasks.goal: The contract defines the WebSocket sync protocol (join/leave, operation batches, ack, presence, reject, reconnect catch-up) as versioned JSON Schema with fixtures.
tasks.why: Realtime and SDK need one message language over the contract operations (AD-1, AD-2, AD-3).
handoff: Closed P1-04: sync protocol as JSON Schema 0.1.0 with 12 message types (6 client→server, 6 server→client), 14 valid/20 invalid fixtures plus reconnect and session sequences; 66 tests green.

reject carries the seven P1-05 wire codes; fixtures-gate/ holds the two Polier gate specimens (byte-identical copies, test-enforced); the 77-fixture parity corpus and all existing tests are untouched.
Review pass with 4 minor advisories (hello-first, wrong-order assertion, snapshotRef board/seq, serverSeq 0 bootstrap) to settle before realtime; P1-05 adds the errors.<camelCase> keys.

tasks.title: API resources and error codes
tasks.goal: The contract defines REST resource envelopes and one error envelope whose codes map to translation keys errors.<CODE>.
tasks.why: SDK, backend and web need one resource/error shape; user-visible errors must be translatable (AD-8).
handoff: Closed P1-05: REST envelopes for workspace/board/note/card (list/get/create/update/delete, requestId, cursor+limit 1-100, items/nextCursor) with refs to the P1-01 entities; 55 API fixtures.
errors.schema.json maps the 7 UPPER_SNAKE codes by oneOf to lowerCamelCase keys errors.authRequired..; all seven keys exist in de/en/en-XA; language-check green; 88 contract tests.
Review pass with 2 minors: no get-request envelope (GET requestId transport noted in docs/contracts.md by P1-06) and a stale comment already fixed. API fixtures live in fixtures-api/.

tasks.title: Contract documentation, ADR and 0.1.0 metadata
tasks.goal: docs/contracts.md and an ADR document the contract and its versioning; board.contracts[] carries the contract metadata for the contracts gate; the stage closes at contracts 0.1.0.
tasks.why: The contract must be documented and discoverable before the engine and backend build on it (AD-3).
handoff: Closed P1-06: docs/contracts.md is the contract 0.1.0 entry point (3 families, 16 schemas, fixture corpora/counts, codegen+parity, SemVer rules, board.contracts[], logical contracts@0.1.0 tag).
ADR-0005 Contract and versions records the schema-first decision, consequences and alternatives; the board decision ADR-0005 now carries its file.
Review pass; 3 minor docs findings fixed (dependant step, gate-vs-table bump caveat, base-URI placeholder) and tag naming aligned (contracts@0.1.0; git release tags stay v<semver>).

tasks.title: Contract overview in the preview
tasks.goal: A permanent preview page shows the contract schemas, operation types and fixture counts, updated with every contract or preview change.
tasks.why: The owner wants a visible intermediate state during the contract stage (demo cadence).

decisions.title: Monorepo with packages, services, apps, tools and infra
Local-first build until the GitHub switch
Remote phase as the last stage before v1
Contract v1 text limits and board visibility

open_questions.question: Product name (working title: Project air) (needed before stage: v1).
Package manager and build orchestration for the workspace.
CRDT: open-source library behind an own interface (proposal) or own algorithm (needed before stage: realtime).
Auth: build it ourselves (proposal) or a self-hosted open-source server (needed before stage: backend-core).
Reference hardware for the 60 fps target (needed before stage: engine-spike).
Who builds the engine: a person with C++/graphics experience or agents under close guidance (needed before stage: engine-spike).
Which import formats, after a legal check of their terms (needed before stage: value).
Pricing model for v1 (needed before stage: v1).
Version scheme: 0.0.1 plus letter entries (proposal) or four-part.
open_questions.answer: SemVer 0.0.1 plus letter entries for unpublished intermediate steps (owner, 2026-10-25).

open_questions.question: AI-written release notes workflow: yes or no.
open_questions.answer: No AI-written release notes for now; optional later (owner, 2026-10-25).

open_questions.question: i18n library or own thin layer on Intl.
open_questions.answer: ICU MessageFormat message files now, framework-neutral; an established ICU library follows when the web framework is chosen (owner, 2026-10-25).

open_questions.question: German spelling and locale.
open_questions.answer: Always ss, never ß; one German file with locale de-DE; no separate de-CH (owner, 2026-10-25).

open_questions.question: English visible at launch or prepared only; who translates further languages (needed before stage: v1).
Canvas collisions: clear layers only (proposal) or gentle nudge (needed before stage: engine-core).
Trackpad default: two fingers pan, pinch zooms (proposal) or scroll zooms (needed before stage: engine-core).
Zones as containers: zones keep their content and move it as one operation (proposal, needs a decision record and migration) or zones are only visual frames?

Performance target split: the engine-spike exit says 60 fps with 50,000 rectangles, the canvas catalogue L01 names 10,000 objects at 60 fps and no long task > 16 ms. Which target applies to which stage gate?

status.reason: Eleven stages with exit criteria, the remote stage and eighteen owner questions are listed in STATUS.md during foundation; shrinks as questions are answered and tasks finish.
